data.name: Humayrah
data.gender_notes: Humayrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A companion or a friend of Allah, derived from the root word 'humayr' meaning 'to be with' or 'to accompany'. The name Humayrah carries the meaning “Companion of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humayrah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A believer who is always in the presence of Allah, seeking His guidance and mercy.
data.etymology: Humayrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humayrah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: حميراء
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من الحمرة، يعني الحمراء اللون أو البيضاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حميراء هو اسم علم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، مشتق من الحمرة، ويعني الحمراء اللون أو البيضاء. وقد ورد ذكر هذا الاسم في بعض المصادر العربية، ويرتبط بالخصال الحميدة مثل الحمرة التي تعبر عن الجمال والصفاء.

in_urdu.name: حمیرا
in_urdu.meaning: حمراء رنگ کی، خوبصورت، سفید رنگ کی
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمیرا ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے حمراء رنگ کی، خوبصورت، یا سفید رنگ کی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں خاص طور پر مقبول ہے، اور اس کا تعلق حسن، خالصی، اور نیکی جیسے اوصاف سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हमायरा
in_hindi.meaning: लाल रंग की, सुंदर, श्वेत वर्ण की
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमायरा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है लाल रंग की, सुंदर, या श्वेत वर्ण की। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है, और यह नाम अच्छे गुणों जैसे कि सौंदर्य, पवित्रता, और अच्छाई से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: حمیرا
in_pashto.long_meaning: حمیرا د ښځو یو نوم دی چې په عربي ژبه کې ریشه لري. دا نوم د سورې رنګه، ښکلۍ، یا سپینه رنګه معنی لري. په افغانستان کې، دا نوم د افغان مسلمانو میرمنو په منځ کې ډیر مشهور دی، او دا د ښځینه نومونو لپاره یو ښه انتخاب ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Humayrah
in_english.long_meaning: Humayrah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the word 'humaira', which means 'reddish', 'beautiful', or 'white in color'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with beauty, purity, and kindness. The name Humayrah has been used historically in various Muslim cultures and is still popular today, symbolizing desirable qualities such as modesty, compassion, and inner beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Humayrah signifies a steadfast companion, often used to describe a devoted follower or a faithful friend. In Islamic culture, it is a beautiful name for a child, symbolizing the desire for a strong bond with Allah and the importance of living a virtuous and compassionate life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Humayrah represents the deep longing and commitment to be in the presence of Allah, to accompany Him in every aspect of life. It serves as a reminder of the sacred bond we share with Allah and the importance of staying true to that bond through acts of worship, kindness, and obedience.
